title: The Carters' Cellar
description: Something has been getting into the Waerman's Rest through the cellar drain, and Hesta Orrow would like it dealt with before it starts on the beds.

go_down.title: Down the trap
go_down.objective: Find out what has been getting into the cellar.
go_down.journal: Hesta says she is losing a barrel a week and it is not the carters. There is a drain in the cellar the width of a man's shoulders and she has stopped going down alone.

the_drain.title: The grate has been moved
the_drain.journal: The rats came up the drain, which is what rats do. What rats do not do is lift a grate that has been mortared in for thirty years and set it back down square.

cleared.title: Dealt with
cleared.journal: Killed, cleared, and the grate wedged with a baulk of pine. Hesta paid out of the till and did not ask me what I thought about the mortar, and I did not tell her.

the_way_in_found.title: There is a way under the city
the_way_in_found.journal: The drain is not a drain. It runs twenty feet and drops into a cut stair under the outer quay, and there is a line hung on iron rings at the turn of it, and the line is dry, and it is used. Half of Waerhaven is standing on a floor that somebody else is walking about under.
